name: China Merchants Expressway Network & Technology Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Merchants Expressway Network & Technology Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates as a highway investment and operation service provider in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Investment Operation, Transportation Technology, Smart Transportation, and Traffic Ecology segments. The company also offers full-process consulting and engineering technical services; and general contracting of engineering, design and construction, and project management services.
